description: Produce a polished A4 PDF in the exact Vizuara × Ramco house style — terracotta accent (#BF654E), Helvetica Neue, section-number badges, status pills (DONE/~50%/PLANNED/TO BE DECIDED), sage exit-criteria callouts, gantt timelines, and hairline tables. Authors HTML+CSS and renders it to PDF with headless Chrome (the same path that produced the reference doc). Use when the user wants a Vizuara proposal, engagement roadmap, milestone report, or any client-facing PDF that must match the established Vizuara×Ramco look.
